senses.gloss:
mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं)
Hidden, concealed.
n. (-ढं)
1 A solitary or private place.
2 A private part.
3 A mystery.
E.
गुह to hide, affix क्त, deriv. irregular.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
One who goes about privately.
m. (-रः)
A secret emissary.
E.
गूढ, and चार practice.

m. (-री)
A secret emissary, a spy.
E.
गूढ, and चारिन् who goes.

m. (-जः)
The son of a concealed birth; born privately of a woman whose husband is absent, the real father being unknown; this is one of the twelve forms particularized in Hindu law.
E.
गूढ hidden, and ज born; also compounded with पुत्त्र a son, गूढजपुत्त्र.

m. (-डः)
The wagtail.
E.
गूड secret, and नीड a nest.

m. (-थः)
1 Mind, intellect.
2 A bye-path, a hidden way.
E.
गूढ secret, and पथ a road; whose path is unperceived.

m. (-द् or त्)
A snake.
E.
गूढ hidden, and पाद a foot, the final vowel rejected; also being retained गूढपाद nom. (-दः)

m. (-षः)
A spy, a secret emissary, a disguised agent, &c.
E.
गूढ concealed, and पुरुष a man.

n. (-तं)
Secret intelligence, private communication.
E.
गूढ secure, and भाषित what is said.

m. (-र्गः)
A subterraneous passage, a defile, a bye-road, or secret way.
E.
गूढ concealed, and मार्ग a road.

m. (-नः)
A crow.
E.
गूढ secret, and मैथुन copulation.

m. (-र्च्चाः)
A frog.
E.
गूढ hidden, and वर्च्चस light, warmth; perhaps an idea is implied analogous to that of cold blooded animals: some explain it वर्च्चस् foeces, whose excrement is unknown.

m. (-क्षी)
A concealed witness, one placed by the plaintiff, so as to overhear what has been said by the defendant.
E.
गूढ^1, and साक्षिन् a witness.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20161210. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/323, batch 306.

m. (-ङ्गः)
A tortoise.
E.
गूढ, and अङ्ग body, hidden in his shell.

m. (-ङ्घ्रिः)
A snake.
E.
गूढ, and अङ्घ्रि foot.

m. (-न्नः)
The son of concealed birth: see गूढज.
E.
गूढ privately, and उत्पन्न born.
